title: fix(metadata-protocol,runtime,app-shell)!: refuse a save or draft publish naming a package that is not installed
body:
Fixes #26708

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here — content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx (no `skills/**` page teaches saving into a named package: `skills/objectstack-api` names `?package=` only as a read parameter)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`/meta` 保存时若 `?package=` 指向本部署未安装的包，所有类型（不只 flow）的草稿和直接保存都会被拒（422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`，什么都不写）；`publish-drafts` 对未知包 id 先回 404；Studio 打开不存在的包显示"未找到包"，未知栏目显示"页面不存在"。
- 为什么改：之前拼错包 id 也能保存成功，生成挂在"幽灵包"下的对象/仪表盘/页面，没有命名空间、无法卸载或导出，`publish-drafts` 还会把它们发布上线。
- 风险与回滚：只收紧请求，不改存储形状；已存在的幽灵行照常可读，可用 `discard-drafts` 清理。回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。夹具改动量大（约 50 个测试文件改为先安装包），是规则收紧的直接后果。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`（`uninstalledNamedBaseRefusal` 与 `saveMetaItem` 的调用点）、`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`（publish-drafts 的 404 位置）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`（`pkgMissing` 判定）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 4417` 后登录，`PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/x?mode=draft&package=com.example.nosuch` 应回 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`；再打开 `/_console/studio/com.example.nosuch/data` 应看到"未找到包"。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`** — the flow-only named-base rule (#20863) is now one private helper, `uninstalledNamedBaseRefusal`, and `saveMetaItem` asks it for every type, draft and active, on authoring saves (not on the `migrate-stored` and `package-duplicate` rewrites of stored rows). A save naming a package id the registry does not hold is refused `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` with `packageId` and the ADR-0070 docs link, before anything is written or registered. The flow arm (`tenantAuthoredWriteRefusal`) calls the same helper, so its sentence is unchanged byte for byte and other types get the same sentence with their type name. The `sys_metadata` sentinel, a save naming no package and a save naming an installed package are unchanged.
- **`@objectstack/runtime`** — `POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts` on an id the registry does not hold answers `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` (the `GET /packages/:id` answer, the existing unknown-id code) before the protocol is asked, even when drafts are stored under that id. The check sits after the capability probe, like `discard-drafts` and the commit trail, so a host that cannot publish still answers 501. No error code was added. Stored rows under such an id are not migrated or deleted.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`** — `/studio/ID/…` for an id the package list does not hold renders "Package not found" (no pillars, no Changes / Publish / create-app, one button back to the Studio landing). A pillar segment Studio has no pillar for renders a not-found state instead of falling through to Interfaces. It reads the existing `GET /api/v1/packages` (no new endpoint, still one request): a switcher entry counts as installed; otherwise the id is looked up among every listed id, so kernel packages the switcher hides still open. A list that failed to load leaves the builder as it was.
- Docs: one paragraph in `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`; changeset `26708-named-base-every-type.md` (patch on the three packages, BREAKING banner, both declaration lines).

## Why

`PUT /api/v1/meta/:type/:name?package=ID` stored the item bound to `ID` even when no installed package had that id, as a draft or live, and with no manifest the object namespace rule was skipped too. `publish-drafts` on that id then put the drafts live, owned by a package that cannot be uninstalled or exported. Only `flow` refused it.

## Tests

- New `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.named-base-every-type.test.ts` (13 tests): object, dashboard and page, draft and active, refused with the envelope (`code`, `status`, `packageId`, message first sentence) and nothing inserted or registered; the flow arm's exact sentence; a plural type spelling; controls for an installed package, the sentinel / null / no package, and the two server-side rewrites.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-draft-doors-unknown-package.test.ts`: drafts stored under an unknown id are not published (404, the protocol is not asked, no visibility flip); controls that a known package still publishes and an unknown id's drafts are still discarded.
- New `ui/…/StudioDesignSurface.notFound-26708.test.tsx` (10 tests): not-found on all four pillars with no pillar links or package actions and one list request, the way back, controls for a listed package, a kernel package and a failed list, and the unknown pillar segment.
- Red first: on the base tree the protocol pins fail 7 of 13 (the 6 controls pass), the runtime pin fails, and the Studio pins fail 6 of 10 (the 4 controls pass).
- Fixtures: about 50 test files across metadata-protocol, objectql, runtime and rest saved into package ids that were never installed. Each now installs the package it names, as a boot or `POST /packages` does (`authored`, or `code` where the file's premise is a shipped package). Where the package's closure now judges a view's object (`list-view-object-outside-closure`), the fixture registers the bound object under the package or declares the owner as a dependency. None of these widened the rule.
- Dogfood: three files saved into package ids no boot installs (`package-first-authoring`, `package-uninstall-revokes-named-grants`, `flow-shipped-name-published-door`). Each now creates its base package first through `protocol.installPackage` (as `POST /api/v1/packages` does) under a valid reverse-domain id with its own namespace; the old ids used underscores, which the install door refuses as invalid package ids.
- `StudioDesignSurface.flowCanvasChip-11665.test.tsx`: the zh tooltip assertion now waits for the lazily fetched `studio` catalogue it reads (it answers `en` until the zh catalogue lands and re-renders the pillar). It passed before only because of module load order; adding two keys to `i18n.ts` changed that order.

- Package suites on the final head (`48af4d05fc`, after merging `main` at `96e7a4335c`, which holds #26853's draft-door query refusal in the same handler): `@objectstack/runtime` 7468 passed / 19 skipped, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 21679 passed / 26 skipped, `@objectstack/objectql` 8843 passed, `@objectstack/rest` 6513 passed / 326 skipped; `typecheck` exit 0 on all four. UI `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design` + `metadata-admin`: 835 files, 8321 passed / 1 skipped; `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` exit 0.
- `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`: the new protocol test's engine double answers `delete`, `findOne` and `update` it never reads; recorded with `pnpm check:engine-double-contract --write`.

## Acceptance notes

- How rows already stored under an uninstalled id surface (live, on one dev DB written by `main`, then booted on this branch): the active row still reads (`GET /meta/dashboard/NAME` 200) and still lists under `?package=ID`; its draft still reads; a save naming the id is refused 422; `publish-drafts` answers 404; `discard-drafts` answers 200 and removes the drafts; the id is not in `GET /api/v1/packages`, so Studio shows "Package not found" for it.
- Two doors still write or publish under such an id, both outside this card's ruling: a save naming NO package for an item whose active row is bound to the phantom id inherits that binding (#11087), and the per-item `POST /meta/:type/:name/publish?package=ID` publishes a phantom-bound draft (200). Both only reach rows written before this change.
- Studio's recent-packages list can still hold an id that later reads "Package not found"; the not-found page offers the way back.

## Verification

- Live red/green on `pnpm dev -- --fresh`, signed in as the dev admin, same probe on both trees. Base (`4f05de4`): six `PUT /api/v1/meta/{object,dashboard,page}/NAME[?mode=draft]&package=com.example.nosuch` all answered 200 and stored the rows bound to that id; `POST /packages/com.example.nosuch/publish-drafts` answered 200 while `GET /packages/com.example.nosuch` answered 404. This branch: the same six saves answer `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` ("Cannot save dashboard 'ghost_dashboard_a' into package 'com.example.nosuch': no package with that id is installed in this deployment, …"), `publish-drafts` answers `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`. Controls unchanged on both: a save naming no package (200), and a package created through `POST /api/v1/packages` then saved into and published (201, 200, 200).

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `48af4d05fc`: 105 commands, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe; all 105 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "105 derived, 105 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".

- Full dogfood once on the final head `48af4d05fc` (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`): exit 0, 327 files passed / 3 skipped, 2683 tests passed / 20 skipped.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/spec` untouched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (Scoped to the touched files on the final head: root ESLint exit 0; `ui` ESLint exit 0, 0 errors, 14 warnings, all on lines this PR did not write — the one inside the edited effect is the existing `setPkgWritable(undefined)` call.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
